feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Texas is a blue state after 2026 midterms, at least for now
entry.summary: Democrats didn't just win the U.S. Senate and governor races in Texas. They won every statewide contest and will take control of the Texas House, making the state a blue one, at least for now.

entry.title: A fiery end to a NASA mission that captured some of the universe's brightest events
entry.summary: NASA's Swift observatory is set to re-enter the atmosphere on Wednesday after two decades of gathering data.

entry.title: Smokejumper flips Montana house seat held by GOP for three decades
entry.summary: Union leader and former wildland firefighter Sam Forstag has won a House seat in Montana that Republicans have held for three decades.

entry.title: What's the future of the Democratic party in Texas, amid historic midterm wins?
entry.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with former Texas state Sen. Wendy Davis, a Democrat, about Texas flipping blue and what it means for future elections.

entry.title: How well did polls predict the blue wave?
entry.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with Anna Greenberg, a Democratic pollster, about what polls captured (and underestimated) after Democrats performed stronger than expected in midterm elections.

entry.title: Another young Democratic Socialist mayor: David Morales wins in Providence, R.I.
entry.summary: At 28, Democratic Socialist David Morales is set to be Providence, R.I.'s new mayor. Like New York City's Zohran Mamdani, he's framed his campaign on affordability issues.

entry.title: South Carolina winner Annie Andrews talks about her win and the path ahead
entry.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Democrat Dr. Annie Andrews, who bested Republican candidate Darline Graham, the incumbent and sister of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham.

entry.title: Some historic firsts from the 2026 midterm elections
entry.summary: Tuesday was not only a night of Democrat victories in midterm elections, but of historic firsts — including the first openly gay man elected to the Senate and the first Black woman elected governor.

entry.title: High class suspects in Ian Rankin's new novel 'The Heights'
entry.summary: Writer Ian Rankin takes us to the underbelly of uber wealthy London life in his new novel The Heights.

entry.title: Rahm Emanuel maps out a vision for what Democrats can achieve after taking Congress
entry.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with former congressman and Obama advisor Rahm Emanuel about what Democrats' strategy should be, now that they'll soon control both houses of Congress.
